title: I couldn't show this screen
body: Something went wrong on this screen. The menu still takes you to the others. Try again; if it stays broken, copy the error details and add them when you report it. The details hold only the error's name, its message and the component it came from.
appBody: Something went wrong in the app. Try again; if it stays broken, close kalan and open it again. The error details hold only the error's name, its message and the component it came from.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select the details below and copy them yourself.
